title: Handle Anonymous Session File Uploads
description: In this PR https://github.com/polywrap/evo.ninja/pull/587 a problem was introduced where files uploaded within the "anonymous" workspace do not get applied to the new chat workspace you create when submitting a prompt (mentioned here: https://github.com/polywrap/evo.ninja/pull/587#discussion_r1427911231). This needs to be fixed.
